# MathLive helper sounds

Original WAV assets from MathLive 0.101.0 (MIT), not the JavaScript engine.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathlive/-/mathlive-0.101.0.tgz
Package SHA-512 integrity was checked against npm registry metadata before extraction.
Copyright and permission notice: LICENSE.txt.

Served as fallback only for IZZI components/js/sounds paths when no usable archived body exists.
The original upstream 404 records remain unchanged. These sounds are available in capture and replay for every book.
